name: Türkiye
summary: Very strict: buying, possessing or using any drug is a crime (2–5 yrs). First offences usually get a 5-yr deferred prosecution with at least 1 yr of probation and drug tests. Selling: 10+ yrs.
callingForHelp: Health workers must report signs of a crime (TCK 280). A user who asks for treatment before any investigation starts is not punished and need not be reported (TCK 192/4).

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is UN Schedule I; mushrooms containing it are prosecuted as drugs. Possession/use: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191).

dmt.note: UN Schedule I (ayahuasca contains DMT). Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is UN Schedule I; the status of ornamental cacti was not confirmed. Possession/use: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191).

dox.note: DOM, DOB and DOC are UN Schedule I. Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

nbomes.note: 25I-, 25B-, 25C-NBOMe are UN Schedule I. Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is UN Schedule II. Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T compounds are not UN-controlled; national scheduling not confirmed.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT has been controlled since Dec 2013; other 5-MeO tryptamines not confirmed. Possession/use: 2–5 yrs.

cannabis.note: Possession/use: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191), +50% near schools, hospitals etc.; first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation and tests.

ketamine.note: Prescription-only anaesthetic; unprescribed supply of such medicines is prosecuted like dealing (TCK 188/6). Exact scheduling not confirmed.

mxe.note: UN Schedule II since 2016. Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

dxm.note: Not UN-controlled; national control and prescription status of dextromethorphan not confirmed.

nitrous.note: Not a controlled drug; a 2025 public-health institute report says sales face no specific legal restrictions and calls for rules.

amphetamines.note: Amphetamines are controlled (supply penalties +50%); ADHD stimulants are prescription-only. Possession: 2–5 yrs.

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. Buying, possessing or using: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); first offence usually deferred prosecution with probation.

cocaine.note: Possession/use: 2–5 yrs (TCK 191); supply penalties are increased by half for cocaine and heroin.

alcohol.note: 18+. Shop sales banned 22:00–06:00; no sales at schools, hospitals, stadiums or petrol stations, or near schools/places of worship.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II (possession/use: 2–5 yrs). National status of GBL and 1,4-BD not confirmed.

opioids.note: Heroin/morphine possession: 2–5 yrs; supply penalties +50%. Prescription opioids are legal only with a prescription.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only; some tramadol products need a controlled 'green' prescription. Unprescribed supply: TCK 188/6.

benzodiazepines.note: Controlled prescription psychotropics; supplying them without a prescription is prosecuted like dealing (TCK 188/6).

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; Syrian rue is not known to be controlled; ayahuasca contains DMT.
